No Result View All Result Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us Hausa Edition Home News Politics Business Sport Football Health Entertainment Education Opinion Editorial Columns Others LeVogue Magazine Conferences National Economy Contact Us No Result View All Result No Result View All Result 2027: Kaduna Govt Gives APC Chairmen Vehicles For Campaign by Nonye Ekwenugo 5 seconds ago in News Share on WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X Telegram The Kaduna State Government has distributed campaign vehicles to All Progressives Congress (APC) chairmen in eight local government areas of Zone One ahead of the 2027 general elections.
The commissioner for local government and chieftaincy affairs, Hon. Sadiq Mamman Lagos, who presented the vehicles on behalf of the state government, charged the beneficiaries to use them for grassroots mobilisation and ensure electoral victory for the party.
He said the distribution was part of efforts to strengthen the party’s structures and enable its officials to reach communities, wards and polling units to canvass support for APC candidates.
Mamman Lagos said similar distributions had been carried out in Zones Two and Three, adding that the exercise aimed to improve the party’s mobilisation capacity across the state.
“We have done Zones Two and Three, and now we are doing Zone One. We are distributing these vehicles to you because we want you to deliver Zone One to us,” he said.
He urged the beneficiaries to use the vehicles for peaceful, issue-based campaigns, voter education and public enlightenment. The commissioner also charged them with visiting communities, explaining the programmes and achievements of APC-led governments, and convincing residents to support the party through constructive engagement.
Also speaking, former Kaduna State Governor and APC senatorial candidate for Kaduna North, Mukhtar Ramalan Yero, described the distribution as a welcome development, saying logistical support was necessary for effective grassroots mobilisation.
He said the vehicles would enable party officials to reach communities and canvass support for candidates ahead of the elections.
Yero urged party members to remain loyal to the leadership and work together to strengthen the party’s structures ahead of the 2027 elections.
